args.title: Corvid Packaging Newsletter: Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, widening the gap between spot and contract pricing.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, so surcharge costs will fluctuate more closely with fuel market movements.
- Corvid's companion analysis found that shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least overall.
